name: Multi-repo, image-embedded (entrypoint-driven)
description: Demonstrates docs/extensions/lifecycle-hooks.md's multi-repo section, entrypoint branch: the same two toy repos as 05-image-embedded-multi-repo-hook.json (see app/server/example/images/multi-repo-demo/), switched by the identical script - but invoked directly from this profile's own command (no hooks declared at all) instead of a hook, so the switch happens once, at container-create time, before the long-running process starts. There is no way to re-switch without recreating the devtainer: with no hooks entry, `dockside hook run` has nothing to dispatch. Build the image first: docker build -t dockside-example-multi-repo:latest app/server/example/images/multi-repo-demo/. The two profiles' command/hooks fields are the only difference between them - deliberately, to isolate exactly what changing that one axis (docs/extensions/lifecycle-hooks.md's 'what performs the switch') buys or costs you.
